---
title: "How do you test the software that you produce?"
question_id: proj4can
---

```{r}
#| include: false
#| file: ../R/_load_common.R
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
question_code <- "proj4can"

nordic_countries <- c(
  "Finland", "Norway", "Sweden", "Denmark", "Iceland", "Estonia"
)
country_groups <- list(
  Nordics = nordic_countries,
  Germany = "Germany",
  Netherlands = "Netherlands"
)
plot_countries <- countries_from_groups(country_groups)
```

### Free-text responses

```{r}
#| echo: false
source(file.path(book_root, "R/recodes/proj4can_recode.R"))

cleaned_data <- process_text_codes_with_allocation(
  filter = FILTER,
  question_code = "proj4can",
  recode_map = proj4can_recode_map, 
  header = "Testing",
  other = TRUE,
  cache_id = "proj4can"
)

cleaned_data$summary_table
```

The raw-to-category allocation table for this question is in @sec-appendix-recoding.
